FAIL_TO_PASS: class-fields: supports class fields
treeshake-logical-expression: do not optimize the literal value of logical expression if the cache is deoptimized
dynamic-import-this-arrow: uses correct "this" in dynamic imports when using arrow functions
deopzimize-while-included: handles deoptimizations of logical expression while they are inlcuded (#3324)
side-effects-switch-statements: switch statements should be correctly tree-shaken
supports-es5-shim: supports es5-shim
known-getter: handles known getters that modify "this"
reassign-object-literal-2: track reassignments through object literals
conditional-expression-deopzimize-while-included: handles deoptimizations of logical expression while they are inlcuded (#3324)
spread-element-deoptimization: deoptimizes array spread elements
associate-function-return-values-2: Associates function return values with regard to calls
reassign-return-expressions: track reassignments of multiple function return expressions
deconflict-destructured-for-key-side-effects: makes sure to deconflict variables that are destructured for side effects in their key only
side-effects-this: When a constructor is called with the new keyword, changing its this has no side effects
track-destructured-setter: tracks side effects from setters in destructuring assignments
minimal-this-mutation: mutates "this" only if necessary on function calls
self-deoptimization: handles situations where a member expression is deoptimized while being deoptimized
side-effects-only-default-exports: Wraps inlined default exports which are rendered for side-effects only
reassign-pattern-defaults: makes sure reassignments of pattern defaults are tracked
sequence-expression: do not change context of callable in sequence expressions
